page.overview:
What is Mace?

The mace is a slow melee weapon crafted with a breeze rod and a heavy core that is used to deal damage to entities. Attacking while falling negates fall damage and deals additional damage depending on the distance fallen.

A mace can be repaired using breeze rods.

Pressing attack while holding a mace inflicts damage on both mobs and other players. Upon damaging a mob or player, the mace's durability decreases by 1.

If the player hits a mob while falling more than 2 blocks, it deals significantly more damage depending on the distance fallen. Attacks with this new mechanic also deal knockback to the mobs in a small radius. This is called a "smash attack."

entity.description:
A mace is a blunt weapon, a type of club or virge that uses a heavy head on the end of a handle to deliver powerful strikes.

This weapon was used by the Netherrealm's great sorcerer Quan Chi in Mortal Kombat 4 and Mortal Kombat Gold.

This weapon is also very similar to Havik's Morning Star.

Several of Shao Kahn's Extermination Squads wielded versions of these weapons.
